en.title: Movie Scene Map – Interactive Location Database for 13,312 Films, Series, Games, Anime, and Manga
en.hook: An interactive map visualizing filming locations and scene settings for over 13,000 media works worldwide.
key_takeaways: Maps thousands of locations across movies, TV shows, anime, games, and manga
Demonstrates effective geospatial data visualization combined with media metadata
Offers a searchable geolocated database for pop culture enthusiasts and developers
